description:
## Description

"This is a stereo cassette deck with a design that can be operated from the front at a low price.The mechanism uses a horizontal drive system to ensure stable performance for long periods of time with less uneven rotation.A belt drive system using an electronically controlled DC-motor is used as the drive system, and stable performances are brought out by stacking invisible parts such as precision flywheels and precision flat belt.The LH head (Long Life High Density) is used for the recording and reproducing head.This head uses high hardness permalloy as material.The erasing head uses a full-surface ferrite structure for abrasion resistance and a double-gap type with good erasing efficiency.An oil dump type cassette door using special oil for the door opening is adopted.The door itself has a large area and the interior is illuminated to make it easier to see the tape running and to clean the head.The mechanism is independent of the pause, and only the pinch roller is separated from the capstan and the tape is pressed to the head as it is. The first stage employs a low-noise transistor, 2SC1327.In terms of mechanism, performance and reliability are improved by minimizing the use of shield wires taking advantage of the features of the printed circuit board, and linearity (19dB at 0VU or higher) is guaranteed to exceed the limit of the tape itself to ensure dynamic range."

description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck designed to improve and stabilize performance by adopting an easy-to-use horizontal drive.We have achieved stable performance by adopting a front operation system that can be used with amplifiers and tuners, and a horizontal drive system that installs the cassette horizontally.A belt drive system is adopted for the mechanism, and 80mm diameter flywheel (dynamic balance of 1gm-cm or less), thick (3mm) capstan with high accuracy (roundness of 0.15Ï‰ or less), electronically controlled DC motor, etc. are used for the stable running system.Although the mechanism of the tape hold is horizontally driven, it is slightly tilted to the front so as not to degrade the performance in consideration of the operability. The mirror structure allows the tape to be monitored and mounted naturally.The switches are operated using the 2-motor electronic control system that has been used since RS-275U.The RS 670u has been improved. In order to improve reliability, a power transistor has been introduced as a switch element to control the plunger. This solves problems caused by poor contact of the relay and eliminates sparks and noise generated from the contact. There are four plungers and they are used for Play, FF/REW, auto-stop, and recording / playback switching.In addition, in order to improve operability, a slide switch is adopted and a soft touch lock system is adopted.Equipped with an automatic stop device. When the tape is wound, the automatic stop circuit works and the mechanism is released.This automatic stopping device uses a reed switch and an electronic control system that detects rotation from a multi-pole 4-pole magnet that rotates in conjunction with the reel base.The amplifier section uses 18transistors per channel to achieve low noise.A PNP type transistor (2SA721) is placed at the first stage of the reproduction equalizer amplifier to suppress the noise level fluctuation caused by the impedance change of the signal source, thereby reducing the audible noise.In the next stage, a high-gain NPN type transistor (2SC1327) is arranged to ensure sufficient linearity to constitute a 2-stage direct connection circuit.We have also adopted a carefully selected low-noise carbon resistor to improve SN.A dedicated muting circuit and a mono-multi-muting circuit are combined to eliminate noise generated when switching a switch.This automatically mutes for approximately 4seconds when the power is turned on, and for 0.3seconds when switching between recording and playback or turning the power off to suppress noise.To further reduce noise, the erase head and the oscillation circuit block are shielded by a metal case, which also protects the tuner and receiver from radiation noise.In addition, the printed circuit board is enlarged and the output terminals and volume are directly connected to each other, eliminating the deterioration of characteristics due to stray capacitance of the shield wire and improving reliability.A series control type stabilized power supply is adopted for the power supply section to supply a stable power supply of 18v to each part.An HPF head has been adopted for the head.The core material of this head is hot pressed ferrite and the hardness of the material is equal to that of hard glass. It is finished with precision by processing with jewel-like precision diamond tool.Equipped with Dolby NR, noise on the tape is suppressed.This device is IN-OUT capable. When it is switched to IN, an MPX filter is inserted to prevent the influence of the pilot signal of the FM stereo broadcast transmission.Built-in meters have a dedicated circuit and can be used by switching between normal level meters and peak check.Equipped with a dedicated microphone amplifier and volume for mixing. A high power supply of 18v is supplied to the microphone amplifier to ensure linearity of 40B or more.Built-in memory rewind function by counter.Equipped with output level adjustment knob.There was a special wood case sold separately."

description:
## Description

"A cassette deck with a front control system.RS-675U is a model that omits Dolby NR system from RS-676U.The mechanism uses a 2-motor system that uses separate dedicated motors for the drive and reel of the capstan.In the RS 675u, a large flywheel directly connected to a capstan is driven by a high-precision flat belt. Combined with a new cassette holding mechanism, the wow flutter is as good as a direct drive.The head uses an HPF head with excellent high-frequency characteristics.The HPF head is made of ferrite processed at high temperature and high pressure. In particular, the gap part is finished with high precision in the order of microns, so that recording / reproducing is possible up to 25kHz at 19cm/s. Moreover, the head surface is finished with mirror surface, and the shield plate and core holder are made of HPF material with the same hardness, so that the estimated life of 200,000hours is realized.You can can be done by removing the carver of the head part.The front panel is equipped with mirrors and lighting to monitor tape movement.In addition, if the tape is removed, the detection device by the microswitch will work and the mechanism will not operate.An operation method using a micro switch is adopted.The electromagnetic control circuit uses a non-contact switching system with SCR, transistor and diode to improve reliability, and four plungers are used for operation switching.In addition, each button has a display lamp to check the operation status.Equipped with photoelectric automatic stop device using CDs and pilot lamp, autostop is applied at the end of end of the tape and the mechanism is completely released.Equipped with a memory play function.If you turn on the memory switch, set the tape counter to 000, and rewind after running the tape, the tape stops at position 999and starts playback automatically.The new time constant of 70Ï‰ S has been adopted for the equalizer for chrome tape, which improves the SN ratio by 4.5db compared to the conventional time constant.Equipped with a tape selector with built-in chrome tape automatic detection mechanism.When a chrome tape with a sensing recess is set, the bias circuit and bias current are automatically switched for the chrome tape. The tape selector can also be manually operated.The electrical circuit is designed with an emphasis on linearity. The transistor is a high-gain, low-noise type (2SC1327), and the emitter resistance is selected to be small for low noise.In addition, an active filter is inserted in the output stage to cut the high-frequency band of 23kHz or higher at 12dB/oct. to shut out noise sources such as via Threec.Since the line and microphone input are completely separated and sent to the amplifier, the SN ratio and linearity during line recording are improved.There is also a position tuner and an OFF position for quick input switching.The left and right independent volumes are eliminated, and the main volume and balance volume are used to control the volume.The output volume is semi-fixed and mounted on the rear panel.A 2SC1407push-pull system is used for the oscillation circuit and a stabilized power supply is used for the power supply to prevent the influence of voltage fluctuations.This oscillator circuit is isolated by a shield case to minimize via Threec (-50dB or less).Equipped with a level meter capable of peak display.This meter has a built-in circuit for displaying peaks that rise quickly and recover slowly to accurately display the pulse input level.The level display can be used separately from the normal level display depending on the switch.Separately sold Dolby unit can be connected.There was a wood case sold separately."

The tape selector can also be manually operated.Since the line and microphone input are completely separated and sent to the amplifier, the SN ratio and linearity during line recording are improved.There is also a position tuner and an OFF position for quick input switching.An electromagnetic control using a plunger is adopted for the control button of the tape running, and it operates accurately by feather touch operation.The internal lighting of the Play, Record and Pause buttons turns on during operation, making it easy to check the operation.The Record button can be operated independently.Pose lock is available.The left and right independent volumes are eliminated, and the main volume and balance volume are used to control the volume.The output volume is semi-fixed and mounted on the rear panel.A constant voltage power supply is used for the power supply circuit to obtain stable operation and excellent linearity.The oscillator circuit is driven differentially through a constant-voltage power supply to reduce distortion, and the circuit is sealed in a shield case to prevent beat with the tuner.A high-gain low-noise transistor is used in the amplifier circuit, and together with the effect of the constant voltage power supply, the over-margin is 0dB to + 20dB.In addition, a full-scale active filter is installed in the output stage to minimize the via Threec.It is equipped with a newly developed level meter, which can perform peak check operation by switching the switch.The pointer rises at -3dB (Normal-12dB) for a 10mS signal. description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck with an amorphous-Z head.The newly developed amorphous-Z head is used for the reproducing head.This is an analog thin-film head using an MR element (magneto-resistive conversion element) that is completely different from the conventional coil system. Using thin film technology on a wafer substrate, the MR element and 1Ï‰ m-thick high-permeability amorphous layer are used as a magnetic yoke, and a head gap width of 0.5Ï‰ m has been achieved. This has not only dramatically improved S/N ratio, frequency characteristics, phase characteristics, and channel separation, but also enables high-quality playback of recorded tapes.The MR element used in the Amorphous-Z head converts the magnitude of the magnetic field itself into a resistance value, making it possible in principle to reproduce the magnetic field from the DC region. Moreover, it has high sensitivity and low impedance over the entire band, enabling high S/N. In addition, the coil type requires a large correction because the low-frequency output is small. However, the Amorphous-Z head requires a small amount of correction and realizes high S/N of the amplifier section.Moreover, in the case of the Amorphous-Z head, there is no contour effect in principle because the MR element detects only the magnetism guided by the extremely small yoke of 1Ï‰ m width, while the conventional head generates the fluctuation of frequency characteristics due to low-frequency interference (contour effect). Moreover, by realizing the head gap of 0.5Ï‰ m, the high-frequency reproduction limit is greatly expanded. Moreover, the Barkhausen noise peculiar to the MR element is greatly reduced, and the distortion is also reduced by applying electric and magnetic feedback to the MR element for part of the reproduced signal.The RS-AZ7uses a compact recording / recombining head.The thin-film head has an extremely small detection section with a thickness of several Ï‰ m and a depth of 50Ï‰ m. The cross-talk between channels is minimized and the interference between the recording head and the reproducing head (field-through) that occurs during simultaneous recording monitoring is also greatly reduced.In addition, by reducing the track width of the thin-film playback head compared to the conventional one, the level fluctuation due to compatibility is suppressed, and the degradation of high-frequency characteristics due to azimuth deviation is improved, making it possible to record and play back with higher sound quality.Play Direct Position is equipped.In this position, the characteristics of the Amorphous-Z head are fully brought out, and high-quality playback with higher S/N is possible (when NR is off).A virtual battery operation circuit is used for the bias power supply to achieve significant noise reduction.The recording amplifier section is equipped with a unique linear magnefield class AA circuit, and the high bias of bias frequency 210kHz realizes sound recording faithful to the source signal.Equipped with ATC (Auto Tape Calibration) to demonstrate the tape performance.This function records a test signal generated inside the set and detects its characteristics at four points of 400Hz, 3kHz, 10kHz and 15kHz. It also performs high-precision automatic adjustment for bias adjustment, recording equalizer and recording level adjustment. This enables recording with flat frequency characteristics.Equipped with ultra high-speed FF/REW, it achieves a maximum speed of about 70times during play.This allows the C-60tape to be wound in approximately 35seconds.The power assist cassette loading realizes stable tape travel.Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO system, the effective bias during recording is automatically adjusted to greatly improve the high-frequency recording characteristics.Equipped with an MPX filter ON/OFF switch.Equipped with a memory stop function.The front panel uses high-density hybrid material and the chassis structure uses THCB (TechnicHybrid Construction Base) to reduce vibration.Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"A three head cassette deck equipped with linear magnefield class AA.A newly developed direct drive mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.The drive motor of this mechanism employs a D. D. motor with digital servo control. By directly comparing the FG pulse generated by the motor circuit with the reference clock generated by quartz oscillation, the rotational accuracy of the motor is made equal to the clock oscillation accuracy, and accurate rotation is achieved.In addition, the motor is designed to obtain torque approximately three times that of conventional motors, so that accurate tape speed with sufficient margin can be obtained. Moreover, by adopting the direct drive method, rotating parts on the tape travel mechanism are eliminated, modulation noise is eliminated, and aging degradation due to parts such as belts is reduced.The rotor (flywheel) of the DD motor is made of zinc die-cast. The dynamic balance of each rotor is adjusted and torque ripple is suppressed by high-precision machining. In addition, the control circuit and drive coil are integrated on the same board and mounted inside the flywheel receiving plate. The receiving plate performs a shielding effect to prevent the entry of external noise and the generation of unnecessary noise.The chassis uses the TNRC base used in CD players, etc. to reduce sound pressure and vibration transmitted from speakers.Equipped with cassette half power assist loading mechanism and cassette half stabilizer.In the power assist loading mechanism, a special motor drives the cam to firmly position the high-rigidity cassette holder containing glass fiber in the fixed position of the mechanism. In addition, the cassette half stabilizer holds the half from above to minimize vibration of the half itself caused by tape running.Linear magnefield class AA is used for the recording amplifier section.In this method, the voltage control amplifier has an equalizer element in the feedback circuit and outputs a voltage with the recording equalizer characteristics. Then, the current supply amplifier converts this voltage output into a current and supplies a current proportional to the voltage to the head. As a result, the signal magnetic field generated in the head remains the output signal of the voltage control amplifier in both gain and phase, greatly improving the waveform response of the magnetic field.It is equipped with APRS which can accurately set the recording level of digital source.With APRS, when a signal is input in the recording pause state and the APRS button is turned ON, the maximum signal level input after that time can be held and displayed on the meter. Then, simply move the Rec Level knob to move the hold display on the meter to match and set the recording level to an appropriate level.It is equipped with a level meter with range switching function, and 1dB step display is also possible by switching the switch.The head is equipped with a Permalloy3head using PC-OCC winding.Equipped with Dolby HX-PRO.Equipped with two types of noise reduction system, Dolby B and C.Equipped with linear electronic counter, memory stop and memory repeat can be performed.Built-in Class AA headphone amplifier with variable output.Equipped with REC calibrator with independent left and right channels.Equipped with MPX filter with ON/OFF switch.Equipped with auto REC mute.Wireless remote control is included."

This improves the adjustment accuracy of azimuth, etc.It also employs a three head system that uses an efficient wide-gap (4?) recording head and a high-frequency (1?) reproducing head.The Dolby HX-PRO system is installed to improve the recording quality of high-frequency sources such as CDs.The Dolby HX-PRO detects the high-frequency component of a music source that constantly changes, and controls the bias current according to the change to set the optimum bias value for each moment. This prevents over-bias for the high-frequency range and provides a bias amount equivalent to the ideal setting value for the low-frequency range. Since the voltage-controlled amplifier, which is not affected by the load at all, is selected for the waveform, excellent response waveform and low distortion factor are achieved.In the amplifier section of a cassette deck, the phase-frequency characteristics in the high-frequency range change in a complicated manner, causing a shift, which in particular affects the music signal during dubbing, resulting in poor sound quality.The RS-B905has a built-in phase correction circuit to eliminate the phase shift in the high-frequency range, and by keeping the group delay characteristic of the music signal constant, recording and playback faithful to the input signal are realized.Equipped with a REC calibration function that flattens the frequency response by correcting the difference in sensitivity of the tape.It is equipped with a 10khz ¥4db bias adjustment mechanism.Equipped with a wide range 3-color FL peak meter of -40dB to + 18db that covers the dynamic range of dbx.It also has an electronic counter that displays the amount of tape travel.Equipped with a 16repeat performance function that allows one side of the tape to be listened repeatedly.Equipped with an auto REC mute function, you can automatically create an approximately 4-second unrecorded portion when recording.Equipped with a music selector.Equipped with timer rec &Ωplay function.Equipped with an auto tape selector.Equipped with an independent headphone volume."

The voltage control amplifier has an equalizer element in the feedback circuit to output a voltage with recording equalizer characteristics. The current supply amplifier converts this voltage output into a current and supplies the current at the head in proportion to the voltage.As a result, both gain and phase of the signal magnetic field generated at the head remain as the output signal of the voltage control amplifier, and ideal recording is possible without being affected by the load.Equipped with APRS to accurately set recording levels for digital sources with a high dynamic range.When a signal is input in the recording pause state and the APRS button is turned ON, the maximum value of the input signal level after that is held and displayed on the meter. In addition, dbx records can be played by operating the NR selector.The Dolby C NR is a higher quality version of the Dolby B NR. It provides an NR drop from the mid-range range. The motor itself becomes a capstan. By directly driving the capstan, highly accurate transport performance is achieved. In addition, this motor is designed so that the rotor (magnet) section rotates while being connected to the stator (coil) section. Not only the accuracy of the capstan rotation but also the stability is improved. In addition, by detecting the output from the FG (frequency oscillator) built into the flat-faced D. D. capstan around the entire circumference of the rotor, the rotation is accurately controlled and the accuracy of the drop of the dbx system is achieved.In addition, two DC motors that boast stable rotation are installed for the reel and ff/rew. description:
## Description

"Concise G Series CD player with technology developed for the best CD player.The D/A conversion part is equipped with S-Advanced Mash 1-bit DAC adopted in SL-P2000.This system achieves a theoretical dynamic range of 145dB by incorporating a fourth order noise-shaping circuit in the conventional advanced Mash, and is greatly upgraded.The LSI consists of two chips, an S-Advanced Mash and a PWM-output IC, to avoid the influence of digital noise. The PWM output is a Class A push-pull current amplifier to suppress the occurrence of overshoot and undershoot in the PWM waveform and realize an ideal PWM output with a stable peak value.A digital servo system is used for the servo circuit.In this method, the focus, tracking, and traverse servo amounts are optimally controlled according to the disk condition. This improves the access accuracy even for CDs in poor condition, improves the performance of the disk, and suppresses fluctuations in the time axis of the digital signal and the ripple of the servo current, resulting in clearer sound contours and sound image localization.The power supply is equipped with virtual battery operation.This circuit takes advantage of the characteristics of the FET element to prevent noise from the home AC power supply from entering the audio circuit via the reference potential generation circuit.It uses carefully selected audio parts.Each part is considered from both physical characteristics and sound quality. and the information on the CD is transmitted to the subsequent stage without losing the amount of information.In addition, the buffer amplifier realizes stable waveform transmission regardless of complicated loads such as the input impedance of the connected preamplifier and the capacitive load of the connecting cable.ClassAA is also used for the I/V converter of the D/A converter outputs to realize high-speed and high-precision L/R and I/V conversion.A newly developed 96th order digital filter and 5th order analog low-pass filter are combined into a super-clean digital filter for the audio circuit.By eliminating unnecessary noise components, phase characteristics, distortion characteristics and frequency characteristics have been improved.As for the parts that make up the audio capacitors for audio equipment.We also conduct strict sound quality checks on low-pass filters, including printed wiring materials on ceramic substrates.To prevent noise from the digital circuit and servo circuit to the audio circuit, the power supply for the audio circuit is configured independently of the digital circuit and servo circuit to prevent interference between the circuits.A unique single-beam FF-1laser pick-up is used for the pick-up part that reads signals from the disk.Compared with the conventional 3-beam system, the laser light utilization efficiency is higher and the SN ratio of the reproduced signal is improved.Combined with the use of digital accu-servo systems and CCF lens systems, we have also obtained excellent signal reading capabilities that are resistant to disc scratches and fingerprints.In order to suppress the vibration which adversely affects the sound quality of the CD player, a thorough vibration countermeasure is taken.First of all, we have adopted a two layer composite weight base consisting of a metal chassis and TNRC for sound pressure vibration from speakers. This product was developed after repeated studies of material, shape, and bolt position through vibration analysis by laser holography. name: Technics
description:
## Description

"MASH1-Bid CD player with DAC and center mechanism.The D/A converter is equipped with multi-stage noise shaping (Mash) using high-order oversampling technology and noise-shaping technology.In this method, a digital filter oversamples the 16-bit digital signal and pushes the folded signal to the high-frequency band. Then, a multi-stage noise-shaping circuit called Mash compresses the 16-bit signal, and a pulse width modulation (PWM) circuit replaces it with a corresponding pulse. At this point, only low and high bits become one bit, and D/A conversion is performed with no relative accuracy errors in the amplitude direction. This realizes D/A conversion with no theoretical 0cross distortion or non-linear distortion, and can reproduce low-level signals small signals superimposed on large signals without distortion.Equipped with optical digital output of EIAJ standard format.It employs a multi-layer vibration isolation structure and center mechanism that thoroughly eliminates vibration and resonance.Four large insulators are used to reduce vibration from the floor. In addition, an optical deck is placed in the center of the body with a good weight balance and floated by a double insulator made of spring and viscoelastic material to reduce vibration.In addition, in order to reduce vibration caused by sound pressure, a multi-layer composite of metal chassis base and BMC base is used to obtain high vibration damping effect.The line-out circuit uses a classAA circuit unique to Technics. By sharing voltage control and current control with separate amplifiers, faithful waveform transmission that is less affected by load fluctuations is realized, and sound quality in actual use is improved.The power supply circuit is independent of the transformer winding for the audio circuit. In addition, high-quality carbon film resistors, PSX electrolytic capacitors, and audio-only film capacitors selected by thorough trial listening are used to enhance sound quality.Equipped with CD editing function which can select normal time edit or just time edit.In normal edit mode, you can set the length of the tape with the tape length key to display the length and number of songs that can be recorded on the A/B side of the tape. You can also press the Just Time key to change the number of songs to minimize the remaining time on both sides of the tape.It is equipped with a disc link function which is convenient for editing and recording from two or more CDs, and a time fade function which can automatically fade out.Equipped with auto peak search that can easily set recording level on the deck side.You can start playing in about one second with a high-speed linear access system that uses a high-precision linear motor and the direct 20key.It is equipped with functions such as timer play and auto queue.Equipped with 2-step display ON/OFF function.It is equipped with a synchro-edit function. By combining it with auto-reverse cassette decks (RS-TR355, RS-TR555) with a synchro-edit terminal, recording can be started on the deck side just by pressing the play key, and recording can be done automatically on both A and B sides of the tape.Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"The first DAT deck of Technics was developed by bringing together Matsushita'Ωs comprehensive strengths, including Technics audio technology.The deck section utilizes Matsushita'Ωs VTR technology. The head uses an original amorphous head with an amorphous layer deposited around the gap. In addition, in order to ensure the perfect assembly accuracy of the rotary head, a precision die-cast cylinder base is adopted to drive the machining accuracy, and the lead of the lower cylinder, which serves as a guide for the tape load, also pursues micron-order accuracy. Thus, excellent running performance is obtained.In addition, the capstan, cylinder and reel rotations are controlled by a powerful servo system to trace the rotary head accurately to a fine track width.Equipped with a tension regulator based on the know-how obtained in video production, the tape tension is kept constant regardless of the remaining amount of the tape.The A/D and D/A conversion sections employ a dual system in which the left and right sides are independent to solve the phase difference problem.Also, the DA converter output is operated in current mode to improve the speed of D/A conversion.Class AA is mounted on the sample-and-hold circuit for recording and reproduction systems and the output stage buffer amplifier.The class AA circuit is a circuit unique to Technics in which a voltage control amplifier and a current drive amplifier are separated. The sample-and-hold circuit is originally a circuit with a large load capacity, but by operating the voltage control amplifier in a no-load state, accuracy of D/A and A/D conversion can be pursued, and low distortion and high S / N ratio are realized.In addition, by mounting a class AA circuit in the output stage buffer amplifier, pure transmission is possible without being affected by the input impedance of the connected preamplifier or the capacitance load of the cable.In order to remove unnecessary frequencies when over-sampling, it is equipped with a unique super-clean digital filter that combines a 96th order digital filter with increased calculation speed and a GIC type analog low-pass filter.As a result, we have obtained a sharp cutoff characteristic that does not generate components outside the audio band and unnecessary radiation that tend to occur during high-order oversampling.The power supply section is equipped with a unique active servo power supply. By forming a feedback circuit by combining a constant voltage IC with excellent temperature characteristics and a broadband IC with excellent high-frequency characteristics, excellent regulation is achieved and AC noise components are not affected by the power supply.In addition to the large-capacity OFC transformer, an electrolytic capacitor of 36,000Ï‰ F is mounted.By using a toroidal pulse transformer for digital input / output terminals, coaxial cable terminals for electrical isolation between connected devices are mounted, and optical cable terminals are also mounted.A computer-simulated earthquake-resistant structure cabinet is used, and 3mm thick steel plate is used for the top plate.Equipped with wide-scale DDR level meter that supports DAT.This meter uses a dedicated LSI to convert digital data into a 32-segment bar graph, enabling high-precision level display. description:
## Description

"DAT deck equipped with 2ADC and 18-bit recording system.The A/D converter uses a unique 2ADC 18-bit recording system.In this circuit, a small-level input signal is amplified by a factor of four, A/D converted by an A/D converter arranged independently on the left and right sides, and the output is reduced to 1/4by digital operation. name: SV-DA10
description:
## Description

"Mash DAT deck with 1-bit AD/DA converter.The AD converter employs a multi-stage noise-shaping circuit, which is a key technology for the Mash 1-bit D/A conversion system. This AD converter uses a 3rd-order noise-shaping circuit that quantizes audio signals at extremely high speed and in fine detail with a 64-times over-speed pulling operation, and a 2-stage digital filter in a single-package LSI with independent left and right configurations.By high-speed and fine quantization and noise shaping, we have achieved a stable SN ratio of approximately 90dB over 16bits. In addition, we have succeeded in converting minute music signals directly into digital signals by eliminating non-linear distortion and 0cross distortion that were generated by conventional current integration type and continuous comparison type AD converters.In addition, the SV-DA10uses a digital signal processing circuit that performs three fold error correction, the maximum of the DAT standard, to improve the fidelity of digital signals.Mash 1-bit DAC is used for the DA conversion part.The 1-bit DA conversion output based on a high-precision clock signal using a quartz crystal eliminates not only 0cross distortion but also distortion generated at the conventional bit switching point in principle.High-precision integrally molded aluminum die-cast is used for the chassis that supports the mechanism. name: Technics
description:
## Description

"A PCM cassette recorder that integrates advanced electronic circuit technology and video tape mechanism.PCM (Pulse Code Modulation) is used as the recording method.In PCM, the original sound waveform is converted into a binary signal through the process of sampling, quantization, and coding, and then recorded. By this process, complex music signals are converted into simplified signals to minimize degradation.This PCM recording method does not generate any modulation distortion or wow flutter, and realizes flat-frequency characteristics, wide dynamic range, and reduction of harmonic distortion, enabling high-quality recording and playback.The integrated configuration of the PCM processor and VTR enables easy PCM recording and playback.Since the signal recording type is based on the ""EIAJ"" standard, it is compatible with the PCM recording system of the same standard.Two large-scale LSIs are used for PCM digital signal processing.The MN6601is a recording LSI that integrates approximately 10,000elements. It adds error detection and correction codes to A-to-D converted digital data and sends it as video data.The MN6602is a playback LSI that integrates approximately 15000elements. It performs decoding and error correction on the reproduced PCM digital signal and supplies as serial data to a D/A converter.We have developed and adopted dedicated LSIs for A/D, D/A conversion and peripheral logic circuits.The A/D converter is equipped with MA6183, and the D/A converter is equipped with MD6192. They were developed using hard thin film IC technology and precision trimming technology.In addition, peripheral logic circuits such as timing generation circuits for A/D and D/A converters are integrated into a single chip using high-speed and high-density IIL developed by our own new process development. High-density wiring with two layers of aluminum is used, and Schottky composite is used for external buffer section to realize high-speed bipolar LSI with approximately 1100gates.In pursuit of usability, the tape operation control part adopts a control concentrated design with full logic control.The recording level can be adjusted independently on the left and right, and a single fader for easy fade-in / fade-out is installed.You can also press the FF key while holding down the PLAY key to move the tape forward at 8x speed for queue control, and you can also press the rew key while holding down the PLAY key to move backward at 8x speed for review control.When the jump mark lever is turned ON, a jump mark is recorded only during that time, and after that, it automatically jumps over that part and starts playback.Also, if you press the clear lever to play, the jump mark signal will be erased.Equipped with a search function to find an arbitrary position on the tape.During recording and playback, when the searchmark lever is lowered, a searchmark is recorded on the tape. With one push of the lever, a searchmark is automatically recorded for 70seconds, the LED lights up, and when the search key is pressed, queue control mode is automatically activated, and the tape stops at the marked position.Also, if you press the play key after pressing the search key, the player automatically enters the play state from the position of the search mark.This mark can also be erased by playing it by pressing the clear lever like jump mark.It is equipped with a location function that allows arbitrary positioning by the memory operation of the tape counter and the locate key.If you set the button of the locate section to the memory position, the counter position at that point is recorded. If you set it to the memory position, the tape stops at that counter position when you press the ff or rew key. If you press the play key while holding down the ff or rew key, the tape automatically enters the play state from the memory position.Equipped with a liquid crystal tape counter and peak level indicator.The level indicator is equipped with a peak hold function and a playback data check function that shows the quality of the tape being used at a glance.Equipped with a digital in/out connector capable of digital dubbing.Equipped with a remote control terminal and left and right microphone terminals.Timer recording is available."

description:
## Description

"An air check amplifier that integrates an FM/AM tuner, cassette deck and pre-main amplifier.An electronically controlled DC motor is used to drive the capstan in the travel mechanism of the cassette deck, an IC is used in the travel control system, and a DC motor is used to drive the reel. Fluctuations in tape tension during recording and playback are controlled to a minimum by controlling the reel motor current with an electronic circuit.The recording / reproducing head uses an all-Sendust head with high saturation magnetic flux density and low high-frequency loss. In addition to the Sendust head with excellent abrasion resistance, a Sendust mask is used on the tape contact surface other than the core to prevent uneven wear. The head shape is a hyperbolic shape with excellent contact with the tape to prevent disturbance of frequency characteristics.The erasing head uses a 3-gap ferrite head with high erasing efficiency to cope with the high coercive force of metal tapes.It is equipped with an automatic music selection mechanism (TPS) that can start up to 9songs in front and back. It can set the number of songs up to the desired number of songs and detect the number of songs displayed on the address counter by the ff/rew operation, and start up the desired number of songs.In addition, it is equipped with Rec Mute which can make voice-cut and unrecorded parts.Equipped with an FL display that displays peak values in two colors of less than 0dB and more than 0dB.The peak value is clearly displayed with an attack time of 120Ï‰ sec. and a recovery time of 270msec.Equipped with Dolby NR circuit and recording / playback timer standby.The tuner section is equipped with a quartz synthesizer.The front-end uses a high-Q varicap and junction FET to improve the IM interference rejection capability, and the IF stage uses a ceramic filter with excellent group delay characteristics to obtain sharp selectivity characteristics.The reference frequency for locking the local oscillation frequency of the quartz synthesizer tuner is set to 25kHz outside the audio band to prevent leakage into the audio band and improve sound quality. In addition, the synthesizer section employs a unique swallow in counter method and a special frequency division method that uses a prescaler controller to control 1/16and 1/17minute periods prevent spurious interference from occurring in the broadcast band.Presets for 7FM/AM stations are available. In addition, an auto-scan tuning function is installed. If you turn on the auto-scan button and press one push of the up/down key, you can tune to the nearest station. If you turn off auto-scan, manual tuning is also available.Equipped with 5LED signal strength indicator to indicate electric field strength.Equipped with a last one memory function that retains the last receiving station until the next power is turned on.The amplifier section uses a new class A amplifier that combines the quality of class A operation with the high efficiency of class B operation.In this method, a constant bias current is supplied in synchronization with the rest cycle to the output transistor which normally goes into complete rest alternately in order to obtain high efficiency in class B and class AB by a synchronous bias circuit, and switching distortion caused by the rest is eliminated by keeping the output stage active at all times.In addition, since the signal path and bias current path are independent, the output stage always keeps an appropriate operating point. Together with the function of the high-speed response diode, crossover distortion is eliminated and the sound quality of class A operation is obtained.In addition, a new study of the NFB theory was added, and a linear feedback circuit unique to Technics with infinite gain in the NF loop is mounted, and the strain characteristic in the range of audibility is greatly improved.It uses a unique concentrated power block that reduces degradation of high-frequency characteristics due to electromagnetic radiation.The phono equalizer is an ICL circuit without the influence of the input capacitor. It consists of an IC with a differential amplifier circuit using a low-noise FET, an input stage using a current mirror load, and an output stage using a SEPP circuit.It is also equipped with a subsonic filter to cut out unwanted low frequencies.The tone control uses a center defeat type in which the element comes off at the midpoint.Equipped with microphone mixing mechanism, microphone mixing with each source is possible.External unit connection terminal is mounted on the rear panel, and external equipment such as frequency equalizer can be connected.The Rec out terminal is mounted.Equipped with a relay type protection circuit for muting.By using the separately sold remote control box (RP-9645), the set deck can be operated from a remote location."

"This is a quartz synthesizer tuner with the newly developed D/A fusion circuit and other technics technologies.It is equipped with a D/A fusion circuit that has been completed by launching seven types of LSIs and ICs in Shinkai.By integrating the digital section (signal control circuit) and analog section (linear section and signal transmission circuit), which had been independent in the past, and utilizing the power of microcomputer for signal control, basic audio characteristics are improved and stability is maintained.The front end, IF circuit and MPX circuit are controlled by triple quartz control with quartz accuracy, and by refining the performance of traditional DC amplification, DC detection and DC demodulation, realize flat frequency characteristics and separation from the ultra-low band of 4Hz.A digital linear detector is used for the detector and a simple configuration of a high-precision one shot multivibrator and a current mirror constant current integration circuit provides low distortion and wide dynamic range audio signals.It is also resistant to changes in elements and temperature, and achieves stable performance in actual use.A high-rise pulse wave is used for stereo demodulation, and the DC peak sample-and-hold MPX circuit of Technics, which eliminates phase distortion, is mounted as an IC. In addition, a double-PLL MPX signal generation circuit, which controls the generation of the MPX signal with a quartz oscillation signal, is mounted to realize accurate and stable stereo demodulation even in environmental temperature changes.By adopting quartz double convert IF, disturbance of group delay characteristics is eliminated, harmful even order spurious interference waves are sharply canceled, and desired signals are accurately extracted, contributing to ultra-low distortion.Equipped with a self-calculating RF tuning circuit, the self-calculating loop operates as soon as the frequency of the desired station is detected, and the RF circuit is controlled to the optimum receiving state.It is equipped with an auto-IF circuit. When a desired station is received, the microcomputer searches for and judges whether there is an adjacent station. If there is no adjacent station, it operates a high-selectivity normal circuit with ¥400kHz detuning 55dB. If there is an adjacent station, it operates a narrow-band, high-selectivity supernarrow circuit with ¥200kHz detuning 25dB to cut out interference from adjacent stations.FM/AM16station random access memory is mounted.In addition, it is equipped with an auto memory function that allows memory operation with a single button.Equipped with 10db step 3-stage switching scanning level function, reception quality can be checked at channel selection.Equipped with an automatic Midnight muting function, it automatically cuts white noise after broadcasting ends.Using the signal strength lead-out function, the signal strength of the receiving station can be displayed in 2dB steps.Equipped with I/O terminal for PC connection (computer audio interface SH 8070a is required for connection with PC)The FM wing antenna terminal that can be automatically tuned is used as a see-through antenna.When combined with program timer SH-4060, weekly program play including channel selection is possible.It has a memory backup function for about one week."

name: ST-S5A
description:
## Description

"A quartz synthesizer tuner that realizes faithful waveform transmission up to the DC range by using a DC circuit configuration.Equipped with a DC peak sample-and-hold MPX circuit, and combined with the effect of DC, the stereo separation of 60dB, which is the same as 1kHz, is obtained even at 20Hz.The 19kHz pilot signal used for stereo demodulation in the MPX circuit is canceled sharply in the electronic circuit. You can set the tuning frequency while viewing the frequency on the digital display. If you keep pressing the tuning button, the operation shifts to high-speed up/down operation. If you release your finger, the operation automatically enters auto-scan operation, finds the nearest station, and stops scanning.It is equipped with an auto memory function that enables you to set a preset by pressing the memory button.If you press the signal level switch, the FM signal strength is displayed up to approximately 54dB in 2dB steps.It is equipped with a memory backup with a large gold capacitor of 3.3Ï‰ F that does not require batteries, and it compensates for power failure for about one week.Equipped with a switchless FM wing antenna terminal, it can be directly connected to Technics FM wing antenna (SH-F100) and automatically tuned.By connecting SH-4060to the control input terminal, channel switching and time can be set freely.(When SH-4060is connected, ch1to ch8of SH-4060correspond to the preset buttons of FM1ch to 8ch of S5A, and ch9to ch16of SH-4060correspond to the preset buttons of AM1ch to 8ch of S5A.)"

description:
## Description

"A synthesizer FM/AM tuner that improves audio characteristics by realizing DC transmission.In the front-end section, an electronic tuning circuit of double-double-double configuration, which is equivalent to a 7-series varicon, and an RF stage of MOS-FET are adopted, to cope with multi-station and improve the image interference ratio.In the IF stage, the filter is carefully selected to achieve both excellent audio and selectivity characteristics. description:
## Description

"An FM stereo tuner which realizes faithful waveform transmission up to DC region (DC) by quartz synthesizer system.A newly developed 28-pin IC with a built-in microcomputer with more than 15,000elements is used for the PLL circuit and controller of the quartz synthesizer. In addition, the pre-scaler part is also an IC to realize excellent stability and high precision.As a result, the ST-S5realizes high stability of local oscillation frequency, and the circuit from the detection stage to the MPX output stage is DC, and amplification, detection and stereo demodulation up to the DC range are realized.In addition, the reference frequency for stabilizing the local signal is changed from 5kHz to 25kHz by the ICs. By setting it out of the range of audibility range, the signal is prevented from leaking into the music signal.By using a varicap that changes capacitance electrically with DC voltage, the front end is equivalent to a four series varicon. This varicap is especially high-Q back-to-back type and improves the image interference rejection capability of the adjacent station.In addition, a 4-pole MOS type FET is used for the RF amplifier to realize high sensitivity.Three ceramic filters with excellent group delay characteristics are used in the IF stage to achieve both high selectivity and low distortion without switching the IF band.The MPX circuit uses a DC peak sample-and-hold circuit.The ST-S5uses a pulse waveform with a fast rising edge as a switching signal, sampling and holding its peak value to improve the separation. In addition, the DC circuit from the detection stage to the MPX output stage maintains a high level of 20Hz stereo separation, which could not avoid deterioration in the past.Equipped with a jitter distortion removal circuit.The ST-S5uses a steep LC band-pass filter to eliminate jitter distortion, which occurs when the 38kHz signal demodulated by the MPX circuit is affected by high-frequency audio signals and pilot signals.It is equipped with a pilot signal cancellation circuit unique to Technics. After being used for stereo demodulation in the MPX circuit, the 19kHz pilot signal, which is unnecessary for audio reproduction, is removed by electronic circuits.This circuit uses a PLL IC to inject a shaped -19kHz signal into the MPX input to remove only the pilot signal. In addition, the ST-S5is equipped with a cancel-level auto-adjuster to prevent variations in the leak carrier, which is the difference between the required cancel amount and the cancel level.The channel selection can be adjusted in 100kHz steps for each push of the button by the quartz synthesizer.It also has preset memories for six FM stations.Equipped with the last one memory, the station which was received when the power switch was off can be effective when the power switch was on.Built-in battery backup function protects the memory contents.The rear panel is equipped with a connection terminal for FM wing antenna.There is a station index at the bottom of the front panel where you can enter the button number and preset station name."

description:
## Description

"A TV/FM/AM tuner with video sound multiplex broadcasting in addition to TV output.Twin quartz is introduced, and quartz control is introduced in two places of front end part and MPX circuit.The front end section achieves stable tuning by obtaining an accurate tuning frequency through quartz oscillation, while the MPX circuit achieves high stereo separation and low distortion by introducing quartz control.A double PLL configuration is adopted in which the second PLL based on the quartz oscillation signal is multiplied by the PLL in the stereo demodulation circuit. name: ST-G88V
description:
## Description

"TV/FM/AM tuner equipped with twin quartz and classAA circuit.A twin-quartz configuration with quartz control is adopted for the front end and MPX circuit.By using an accurate tuning frequency with a quartz oscillation in the front end, stable tuning accuracy without frequency drift is obtained. name: Technics
description:
## Description

"A speaker system with low distortion using the know-how obtained with the SB-1000.A 25cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The new TC cone is used for the diaphragm of this unit. The TC cone is made of a material with a high Young'Ωs modulus and a material with a high internal loss. It is made into a three layer one plate diaphragm by sandwiching a material with a high internal loss. It has the effect of suppressing divided vibration. The new TC cone uses a new high-crystalline fiber (HXF) for the exterior part of this structure. It is designed to have tensile strength twice as large as carbon fiber, specific gravity 0.75times as large, and mechanical loss twice as large as carbon fiber.In addition, magnetic materials that suppress eddy current generation are used for the pole piece and plate of the magnetic circuit near the voice coil to reduce the distortion at the beginning of the energy conversion. This greatly reduces the current distortion flowing in the voice coil and reduces the third harmonic distortion in the frequency range from 100Hz to 3kHz by 20dB compared to the conventional one.The voice coil adopts a long travel type with a coil winding width of 15.8mm compared to the plate width of 8mm. This allows the voice coil to be driven within a constant magnetic flux even at large input and amplitude, minimizing linearity loss due to magnetic leakage. In addition, 50micron hard aluminum foil is used for the voice coil bobbin to improve input resistance.The mid-range features a 3.2cm dome mid-range.The TC structure is also adopted for the diaphragm of this unit, reducing distortion by suppressing abnormal resonance and split vibration, and improving directional characteristics by narrowing the aperture to 32mm �.It uses a perforated pole piece and a back cavity, and by guiding the air in the rear part of the diaphragm to the back cavity, distortion due to air pressure is eliminated and an optimum acoustic load is applied. This realizes a low-frequency resonance frequency of 650Hz with a small diaphragm of 32mm �. Glass wool with a diameter of 1.25microns is used for the sound absorbing material of the back cavity.A 1.3cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.An aluminum-evaporated polyester film is used for the diaphragm, and stable wide directivity and transient characteristics are obtained from 7kHz to 20kHz. In addition, a lightweight CCAW (copper-coated aluminum wire) is used for the voice coil, and by reducing the weight of the vibration system, the high frequency limit is extended.The enclosure is sealed 18mm thick and has a walnut oil finish on the exterior.Level control is mounted on the rear baffle."

This realizes a lightweight vibration plate of 17mg, about one twentieth of the conventional metal dome type vibration system.In addition, a large magnet with a weight of 1.2kg is used for the magnetic circuit, and the structure is sandwiched between I-type and L-type low-loss yokes. Together with the Taber-shaped magnetic pole structure, the leakage of magnetic flux is suppressed, and strong magnetic field generation is obtained.Unlike the system in which magnets are placed before and after the vibration plate, the vibration plate is strongly driven by a uniform magnetic field at once, and the front surface of the vibration plate is opened widely and uniformly without the influence of the diffraction of sound waves by the magnet lattice.In the leaf tweeter, a high heat-resistant polymer film based on an analysis of the temperature distribution in the vibration plate during driving was adopted as the vibration plate material. As a result, high input resistance that can withstand 20W (RMS) continuous sinusoidal input has been obtained.Because there is no mechanical resonance or inductance component in this leaf tweeter, the impedance is constant from DC to 200khz ultra-high frequency band, and there is no disturbance of frequency characteristics due to impedance fluctuation. Because it is designed with 8� impedance, direct drive is possible without requiring a matching transformer.The oscillating plate radiation surface is structurally divided into two parts. In order to prevent deterioration of the directional characteristics due to interference at high frequencies, a high-precision aluminum die-cast equalizer fin is installed between the two radiation surfaces to achieve excellent directional characteristics.The network is specially designed for the linear phase.In addition, in order to demonstrate the performance of the unit such as the leaf-toter, elements that have been thoroughly examined in terms of performance and reliability are used.The dumped bass reflex system is used for the enclosure.With a low inductance cord by arranging two coaxial cables in parallelEquipped with independent continuous variable level control for tweeters, mid-high and mid-low."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"The top-of-the-line quartz synthesizer DD turntable was completed by making full use of all player technologies possessed by Technics.It uses an ultra-low speed electronic commutator brushless DC motor developed based on the motor of the Technics SP-02cutting race drive unit with the world'Ωs leading torque. It realizes the enormous starting torque of 16kg Ï‰ cm, which is the largest of Technics for consumer equipment.This value is 2.5times larger than that of SP-10mk2, and allows a 10kg ultra-heavy turntable to rotate for 0.25seconds at a constant rotation angle of 30�.The stop mechanism uses both a mechanical brake and an electronic brake that instantaneously activates the reverse rotation drive circuit. This makes it possible to stop a 10kg ultra-heavy turntable in 0.3seconds. In addition, by using both the mechanical brake and the electronic brake, there is almost no shock sound even when the turntable is instantaneously stopped.At the time of speed change, a huge starting torque is used from low speed to high speed, and an electronic brake drive circuit is operated from high speed to low speed, enabling instantaneous switching.In addition, the mechanical brake is maintained in a half-brake state while the machine is stopped to prevent unnecessary movement of the turntable, enabling the needle tip to be protected and precise head-out during recording performance.The SP-10mk3uses top-of-the-line components. In particular, the turntable has a two layer structure consisting of an aluminum die-cast turntable and a 15mm thick copper alloy turntable. It weighs 10kg and weighs 1.1ton-cm.2For example, when tracing the outer circumference of a 30cm record with a 2g needle pressure, the braking torque is equivalent to approximately 10g Ï‰ cm. Therefore, with a 2g needle pressure, a rotational speed deviation of 0% is possible even when playing with 100arms simultaneously.In order to improve rotational performance, we have adopted a unique integrated structure DD in which the rotor magnet of the motor is integrated with the turntable. Therefore, there is no need to stack the case, motor and turntable, and the structure has high accuracy. In addition, the turntable also has a large inertial mass, and stable rotational characteristics are obtained.In addition to this mechanical accuracy, a unique all-around detection FG is used to detect the number of revolutions. Unlike the one point detection method, the detection coil is distributed around the entire circumference of the rotor so that an extremely high-precision FG detection signal can be obtained.The phase control circuit detects the phase difference between the detected FG signal and the reference signal and controls the rotation in the positive direction. A quartz oscillator is used to generate the reference signal in this case.As a result, outstanding rotational performance of 0.015% wow and flutter, and accuracy of within ¥0.001% rotational speed deviation, which exceeds human detection eyes, are realized.The cabinet is made of high-precision zinc die-cast and aluminum die-cast, and the bottom base is made of TNRC, a unique acoustic material with excellent new rod characteristics. These measures emphasize the traditional concept of no vibration and no resonance and realize an excellent SN ratio.It achieves extremely precise rotation by quartz control and also employs a quartz synthesizer system that enables pitch control. This allows adjustment over a wide range of constant speed rotation up to ¥9.9% with a variation of 0.1% below the human eye. The adjustment can be performed in 199ways at 331/3, 45, and 78.26rpm, for a total of 597quartz lock pitches.The pitch adjustment button is installed in the attached control unit and allows fine adjustment in increments of 0.1% with one push. Also, when the pitch is variable, pressing the clear button instantly restores the pitch to 0%.In addition, if you press the pitch lock button at any number of revolutions, the number of revolutions is locked and the word ""pitch lock"" lights up. In this state, the number of revolutions does not change even if you press any other button.When the flash is rotating at constant speed, it appears to stop in yellow-green, but when the pitch is variable, it appears to move in red-orange.The control unit can be used to turn the power on/off, start / stop the turntable, set the rotational speed, and control the pitch.Rotation speed and pitch adjustment amount Highly visible LED is used for the display, and together with the smoked acrylic panel cover, it enables clear digital display.Turntable start / stop and rotation number switching switches are also provided on the body.* About cabinetWhen the supplied screws are used, the cabinet thickness of the mounting screws is 40to 55m. In other cases, screws corresponding to the cabinet thickness are required. The screws are metric screws with nominal diameter 5and pitch 0.8.In addition, we recommend that the cabinet be made of sufficiently thick and heavy material in order to demonstrate its performance."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"A universal tone arm that adopts the world'Ωs first Boron Titanium Pipe arm and boron aluminum head shell.The arm pipe uses the world'Ωs first Boron Titanium Pipe, in which a boron layer is formed on the surface of a lightweight metallic titer with high mechanical strength and high elastic modulus by a special forming method, and a boron diffusion layer is provided inside. This design increases the mechanical strength and suppresses harmful partial resonance such as bending and torsion with an emphasis on sound quality.In addition, the head shell uses boron aluminum, which is a composite refinement of boron fiber and aluminum, to achieve high rigidity and weight reduction.The tone arm uses a high-sensitivity gimbal suspension bearing structure.Both horizontal and vertical bearings A total of 20ruby balls with an extremely low friction coefficient of about 1/3of that of the wheel are used for the bearings, and the minimum initial motion sensitivity of 5mg is realized.A unique variable dynamic damping system is adopted.In this system, the movable weight part in the balance weight is supported by a spring with high strength and damping effect, and the mass of the movable weight is divided by its compliance. In addition, the spring support part is covered with a damping cylinder, and silicon oil is contained inside the cylinder to increase the damping effect of the spring support part by viscous resistance. This greatly improves the low-frequency resonance peak (sharpness Q).In addition, in consideration of the fact that the low resonance frequency changes depending on the compliance and weight of the cartridge used, we have incorporated a magnetic damping adjustment function in order to provide more effective braking. This is equipped with two magnets in the movable weight part, and by changing the distance between these two magnets, the resonance frequency of the movable weight part changes. This reduces the low resonance peak (sharpness Q), flattens the frequency characteristics, reduces the low frequency mechanical impedance, reduces intermodulation distortion and ultra-low frequency noise caused by the warping of records, and enhances cartridge performance and tracing performance.In addition to enabling high-fidelity and high-signal-to-noise ratio reproduction, we have also improved the insulation performance against external vibrations.It is equipped with an arm height adjustment function by zinc die-cast precision 12-row helicoid structure, and the arm height can be adjusted within 20mm."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"System tone arm set with arm base EPA-B500(including cord), arm unit EPA-A501H, needle pressure gauge SH-50P1.EPA-B500EPA-B500is an arm base to which an arm unit can be attached.The EPA-B500has a unique gimbal suspension bearing structure that is mounted on the Technixtone Arm, while the arm unit has a replaceable structure.The gimbal suspension system is a 4-point support system using a high-precision pivot and ball bearings. The structure in which the axis of the horizontal and vertical rotation axes intersect at a single point realizes high sensitivity with an initial motion sensitivity of less than 7mg in both horizontal and vertical directions.This bearing is supported by a precision zinc die-cast base to completely suppress external vibration. In addition, a highly reliable sliding connector is used for the arm unit and arm base to provide a self-cleaning effect when replacing the unit.Equipped with 12helicoid arm height adjustment mechanism, high precision arm height adjustment is possible.Since the output cord has a low DC resistance of 39.5m � / m and a low capacitance (41.5pF/m), it has excellent transmission characteristics.EPA-A501HEPA-A501H is an arm unit for high compliance cartridge.This arm unit inherits the functions of EPA-100and adopts a unique dynamic damping mechanism for the balance weight. The low-frequency resonance sharpness of the arm unit is improved by more than 6dB compared with the normal arm. Moreover, unlike the oil-dump damping system, the low-frequency mechanical impedance does not increase, and the attenuation characteristics below the low-frequency resonance frequency are improved. By this, by selecting the arm unit that matches the cartridge, the resonance peak is dramatically reduced and the low-frequency characteristics are improved.The pipe material of the arm unit is titanium nitride (TiN), which is highly rigid and lightweight titanium with special nitriding treatment. This eliminates the partial resonance of the tone arm and provides an ideal mechanical strength distribution, reducing the weight by 85% compared with conventional aluminum pipes and achieving a mechanical strength of approximately 1.6times.SH-50P1The SH-50P1is a highly sensitive electronic needle pressure meter that uses the piezoresistance effect, which changes electric resistance when stress (needle pressure) is applied.High accuracy is achieved by electronic control using two semi-conductor stain gauges and two transistors, and the needle pressure value is directly read by a large meter.OtherSeparately sold options included the EPA-A501M arm unit for medium compliance cartridges and the EPA-A501L arm unit for low compliance cartridges."

## Description

"MC type stereo cartridge that uses pure boron pipe cantilever.Pure boron cantilever is used for the cantilever.This cantilever realizes light weight and high strength by refining boron, which has the highest specific elastic modulus among existing elements, into a pipe shape by a special manufacturing method.In addition, a laser beam is used to process the tip mount hole for attaching the needle tip to pursue accuracy, thereby obtaining an extremely small effective mass of the vibrator and driving the high resonance frequencies out of the range of audibility.Uses the TTDD (Technics Temperature Defence Damper) developed by Technics.Compared with the commonly used butyl rubber, this material has improved temperature dependency to about 1/3, has excellent viscoelasticity, and is a damper material with excellent cantilever support performance.As a result, there is almost no change in sound quality or deterioration in tracing performance due to changes in room temperature.Uses a one point suspension system using a high magnetic samarium-cobalt magnet.It uses a pure coil structure without an iron core to suppress magnetic loss and distortion due to iron or other magnetic materials. description:
## Description

"MM type cartridge using pure boron pipe cantilever.A pure boron cantilever is used for the cantilever. It is molded only from boron, which has the highest specific elastic modulus among existing elements. Moreover, it is difficult to make solid rods. This material is refined into a pipe by a special manufacturing method to realize light weight and high strength. In addition, a laser beam is used for processing a tip mount hole for attaching a needle tip to pursue accuracy. By this, an extremely small effective mass of the vibrator is obtained, and high resonance frequencies are pushed out of the range of audibility.It uses the Technics Temperature Defence Damper (TTDD) developed by Technics Co., Ltd., which has improved temperature dependency to about 1/3compared with the commonly used butyl rubber. Moreover, it has excellent viscoelasticity and is a damper material with excellent cantilever support performance. As a result, there is almost no change in sound quality or deterioration in tracing performance due to temperature changes in the room.The magnetic circuit uses a mirror-polished HPF core for all magnetic materials such as pole pieces and yokes to obtain excellent transmission characteristics.In addition, the left and right channels are completely separated in the HPF magnetic circuit, and symmetrical arrangement is realized, so that the imbalance between the channels of various characteristics is reduced.It uses a one point suspension system. A disk-shaped magnet is placed at the base of the cantilever, and it is attached to the support pipe with a suspension wire through the same disk-shaped damper.As a result, the supporting point is clearly located just behind the magnet, preventing the occurrence of cross-modulation distortion due to the back-and-forth change of the cantilever and the degradation of high-frequency characteristics due to the increase of equivalent mass seen from the needle tip.By adopting a low inductance design, the effect of addition is suppressed and high performance is exhibited.In addition, the DC resistance is designed to be extremely small, so that noise caused by the resistance component at the amplifier input stage is reduced and a high SN ratio is obtained."

"FM wing antenna with built-in electronic tuning circuit.The SH-F100consists of a resonant circuit consisting of an antenna element with a zigzag pattern, two silicon varactors and coils. name: Technics
description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier developed based on Technics 50A and SU-3600.The final stage of the power amplifier employs a complete complimentary service circuit in which NPN type transistors that operate with a + signal and PNP type transistors that operate with a - signal are to drive while inverting the phases.Switching distortion that tends to be seen in conventional circuits is eliminated because of the smooth configuration that allows current to flow easily by changing the + - signal.In addition, all stages are directly connected to the OCL circuit in the power amplifier section to keep the damping factor flat and reduce the distortion factor.In order to make the most of the circuit characteristics, a differential amplifier using a pair of low-noise PNP transistors with uniform characteristics is adopted at the first stage. Moreover, the common emitter circuit of the differential amplifier is composed of a direct-coupled circuit using a constant current circuit to obtain high stability.The equalizer stage consists of three stages of PNP-NPN-PNP directly connected circuits. The first stage uses a specially selected low-noise PNP transistor to obtain a large gain and greatly improve the SN ratio.The curve change point of the tone control can be switched in two stages each for bass and treble, and the tone control can be adjusted separately for the left and right channels.This tone control is a special combined structure consisting of a resistor and a silver conductor. It is a two volume type of technics that can be used separately for raising and lowering. When one of the tone controls touches the resistor, the other touches the silver conductor, so that only one capacitor is inserted.At the midpoint, both brushes come on top of the silver conductor, so you get completely flat and straightforward characteristics.In addition, it has excellent distortion characteristics with 2-stage direct connection circuit configuration.The volume is a preset volume.If you preset the volume to an appropriate level, the knob will stop rotating at that position.Two tape decks can be connected, and recording and dubbing of two tapes simultaneously is possible.The input impedance of the Phono input terminal can be switched to 3levels.It is equipped with a unique speaker protection circuit that detects DC current so as not to burn the voice coil due to DC current flowing through the speaker.We also provide circuit protection devices to prevent transistors from being damaged due to miswire connections or other operational errors.Easy-connector type speaker terminal is used."

## Description

"Concise G integrated amplifier with single component G series technology.The power amplifier section uses MOSclassAA circuit, an original circuit technology.This circuit employs a pure class A voltage-controlled amplifier using a power MOS-FET as an amplifying element and a class B operating current supply amplifier composed of bipolar transistors. description:
## Description

"The power MOS-FET developed by Technics is adopted, and MOS class AA is realized.In MOS Class AA, MOS-FET is used in a class A operation voltage control amplifier of the class AA output stage. description:
## Description

"This is a Concise Integrated Amplifier equipped with a Technics original linear feedback circuit that realizes theoretical distortion = 0.Going back to the origin of NFB theory, we have adopted a linear feedback circuit that makes NFB work more ideally.This circuit forms an independent feedback circuit that can provide infinite amplification in the NFB loop. In order to solve this problem, the synchronous bias circuit applies a constant bias current to the output transistor and keeps it active at all times, thereby eliminating the switching distortion.New Class A also eliminates crossover distortion, which is another cause of sound nigori.Crossover distortion occurs when the positive and negative waveforms deviate from each other in the front-back direction of the time axis due to excess or deficiency of idling current, and when the rise and fall waveforms themselves do not have ideal squared characteristics and the positive and negative composite voltage characteristics do not become linear. In the new class A, the output transistor always keeps the appropriate operating point because the signal path and bias current are independent, and when combined with the function of the fast response diode with almost ideal squared characteristics, crossover distortion is also 0.The phono equalizer is an ICL low-noise equalizer with the first stage FET differential amplification without the input capacitor.The tone control circuit uses the NF loop of the main amplifier.
