name: Technics
description:
## Description

"An integrated DC amplifier that uses Technics'Ωnew classA circuit.The new classA circuit was developed as a circuit having only the excellent points of classA operation and class B operation, and it is realized by a synchronous bias circuit.This synchronous bias circuit controls the bias of the output stage in synchronization with the input signal. It has a structure in which a constant bias current is supplied to the - side output stage when the + side signal is being reproduced, and to the + side output stage when the - side signal is being reproduced. In this structure, a constant bias current is supplied to the + side output stage when the - side signal is being reproduced. Therefore, the transistor of the output stage is always active regardless of the presence or absence of the signal and switching distortion does not occur.The circuit of SU-V10consists of an initial stage composed of FET differential circuit and cascode circuit, a voltage amplifier stage with constant current load, a voltage driver circuit for emitter-follower output with A-class operation up to SEPP connected transistors, and a Darlington connected SEPP output stage through a synchronous bias circuit.A straight DC method is adopted in which a capacitor with a time constant is eliminated from the stage between the high-level input and the output terminal of the speaker and negative feedback (NFB). This realizes faithful waveform transmission over the entire audible band from ultra-low band (direct current).In order to suppress DC drift, which is the biggest problem of DC amplifier, the characteristics of the pair elements such as differential and current mirror are precisely matched, and the active thermal servo circuit is mounted.This circuit is designed to compensate for the drift factor itself by actively compensating for the imbalance in the temperature characteristics between elements. The circuit integrates the signal output with an operational amplifier with excellent linearity and accuracy, and drives a heat-generating transistor that is thermally coupled with the signal transistor. The heat-coupled transistor has only a case bonded to it and is electrically isolated from the signal transistor, so there is no adverse effect on the signal.This circuit realizes a high DC stability of 0¥5mv or less under a wide temperature range of -10Ï‰ to 50?.The power transistor uses SLPT, which is equivalent to 200built-in small-signal transistors with excellent high-frequency characteristics. It realizes a high-frequency reproduction limit of 100MHz order and an extremely linear amplification factor from small current to large current.It uses a plugged power block.In this method, large signal and large current components such as electrolytic capacitors, drive circuits, and power transistors are compactly concentrated in an integrated radiator block, reducing the problem of circuit configuration that deteriorates high frequency characteristics such as electromagnetic induction.A large capacity transformer with a margin is used for the power transformer.By floating the coil in a special resin and storing it in a case with a high shielding effect, this transformer minimizes leakage flux combined with the effect of a surplus electric power capacity.The phono equalizer circuit has an ICl configuration in which a low-noise dual FET is arranged as a differential amplifier at the first stage and a coupling capacitor at the input stage is eliminated.Equipped with MC pre-preamp.Equipped with an independent input/rec selector.A remote action switch is adopted to realize straight circuit wiring without deterioration of characteristics.Equipped with a mid-point defeat tone control that provides a flat frequency response at the mid-point.It is equipped with a protection circuit using a relay that also works as a muting when the power is turned on/off.The electrolytic capacitor mounted on the Concentrated Power Block uses a low-impedance super audio capacitor to reduce electromagnetic radiation from the electrolytic capacitor."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"Digital processor with 3-chip configuration Mash 1-bit DAC.The D/A converter is equipped with multi-stage noise shaping (Mash) using high-order oversampling technology and noise-shaping technology.In this method, a digital filter oversamples the 16-bit digital signal and pushes the folded signal to the high-frequency band. Then, a multi-stage noise-shaping circuit called Mash compresses the 16-bit signal, and a pulse width modulation (PWM) circuit replaces it with a corresponding pulse. At this point, only low and high bits become one bit, and D/A conversion is performed with no relative accuracy errors in the amplitude direction. This realizes D/A conversion with no theoretical 0cross distortion or non-linear distortion, and can reproduce low-level signals small signals superimposed on large signals without distortion.The SH-X1000has a 3-LSI configuration with 1LSI of digital filter, Mash and 1-bit DAC and 2LSI of left and right independent DACs including PWM converter. Channel separation is improved by preventing digital noise from entering the PWM chip.The operating clock of the digital filter + Mash and PWM chip is 64fs, and the theoretical dynamic range of 123db is realized.A jitter-free interface is installed to eliminate jitter that occurs in digital transmission systems.In this circuit, data is first stored in 1.5megabit RAM via DSP, then read out from RAM by high-precision quartz clock independent independent from the clock on the sending side, and transferred to the digital filter + Mash chip at the later stage. In principle, jitters are stored in the RAM and become 0when read out.Since this circuit has a slight time lag when the RAM usage is large, two types of RAM usage, Narrow and Wide, can be selected depending on the frequency deviation of the source.This interface conforms to the EIAJ standard and provides excellent signal transmission when connected to other digital devices such as DAT and BS tuners.A DSP is installed to suppress group delay distortion generated around the phase of the low-pass filter. The entire linear phase is realized by phase correction with inverse characteristics to the low-pass filter of the latter stage.It adopts digital emphasis processing by DSP instead of emphasis circuit done by analog circuit.DSP processing simplifies the circuit and improves the S/N ratio, etc.It is designed to operate in high-precision digital PLL mode when the frequency deviation of the input source is large.The phase difference between the digital signal input to the DSP and the clock from the VCO is detected using the RAM. The VCO is controlled by the phase difference output of approximately 10sec. This drives the jitter out of the audible band and enables the generation of a clock with high oscillation accuracy.The power supply section uses a large transformer with vibration isolation structure for both digital and analog power supplies. It also uses an active shunt power supply to reduce power supply voltage fluctuations caused by circuit operation.We have succeeded in suppressing pressure fluctuation to the limit.A classAA unique to Technics is used for the lineout circuit.It uses carefully selected parts such as glass epoxy boards and audio PXS capacitors."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"An amplifier that pursues the ideal waveform transmission in a preamplifier.All stages are class A operation and all stages are FET inputs. The MC pre-preamp of the ICL, the phono equalizer of the ICL, and a full DC amplifier (flat amplifier and buffer amplifier) are added. This allows two MC inputs and one MM input to pass through only one coupling capacitor, while the high-level input is DC-amplified to the output terminal without passing through any capacitor.The flat amplifier and buffer amplifier have a two stage configuration with a SEPP output stage as a dual FET differential amplifier circuit with well-matched input characteristics, cascode, and current mirror load.The output transistor uses a high-ft SLPT to reduce distortion and provide wide and flat frequency characteristics.The MC pre-pre-amplifier is composed of 4para-elements of super-low noise FET, and the phono equalizer is an input stage of differential amplification cascode current mirror load by super-low noise dual FET with well-matched characteristics, thereby realizing ICL.The equalizer section is equipped with an equalizer subsonic filter to cut out ultra-low frequency noise caused by warping of records, etc.The SU-A4is equipped with a DC buffer amplifier in the next stage of the DC flat amplifier to limit the output impedance to 0.2�.As a result, it is possible to add 2500additional power amplifiers based on the conventional output impedance standard, and no signal is transmitted even when a power amplifier is connected with a shield cable of 100m.In addition, since the output impedance is 0.2¥, the damping factor is 40for an 8� load, and the SU-A4achieves high stability so that it can sound for a short time even when a speaker is directly connected to the SU-A4.A protection circuit using a current limiter is mounted in anticipation of a short circuit at the output terminal.As a tone control function, Super Bass / Super Treble is equipped in addition to general bass / treble.The Super Bass allows you to extend the speaker'Ωs frequency response by up to one octave into the lower range with a shelving tone with a steep rise of 12dB/oct. and a boost of up to 12dB. The turnover frequency can also vary continuously from 50to 200Hz to match the speaker.Super Treble can be used in combination with Treble to correct the mid-range and high-range peaks in the frequency characteristics of the cartridge.These tone control functions are inserted between the DC flat amplifier and the DC buffer amplifier with a gain of 1and turned on by a via tone switch. When turned off, the tone control function is in straight DC mode, indicated by an LED on the front panel.The volume uses CP (conductive plastic) resistor with excellent abrasion resistance (no degradation even at 50million revolutions). The surface of the resistor is mirror-finished, and combined with the multi-contact sliding brush, the contact resistance is reduced to 1/ 2of the conventional one.The SU-A4uses two CP volumes per channel (before and after the flat amplifier) for a total of four CP volumes to eliminate minute noise after volume reduction, and the CP resistors are accurately calibrated by a computer to provide a decibel indication of volume.The CP volume is equipped with a loudness tap, and the turnover is switched in two stages.The 500hz is for small speakers and the 250hz is for large speakers.Equipped with -20dB audio muting.Equipped with a REC selector.Two pre-out terminals and on/off switches are used.Comes with removable pocket door and memory card for controls.Gold-plated terminals are used for all rear panel terminals.Equipped with an interlocking AC outlet that can turn the power of the power amplifier on/off.Equipped with two Phono systems and two tape terminal systems."

"This is a control amplifier based on SU-C1010with new and upgraded main parts.A unique low-noise amplifier VGCA (Varibale Gain Control Amplifier) is used to support new-generation digital formats such as DVD-Audio.In VGCA, we have adopted a method in which the gain of the amplifier section itself is changed, instead of the amplifier configuration in which the signal is reduced by the input volume and then amplified, which was adopted in conventional amplifiers, enabling reproduction with less residual noise.A Ni-cd battery is used for the power supply for the audio circuit. The battery can be fully charged for approximately 15hours. When the battery voltage drops, the battery is recharged automatically.In order to support multi-channel audio such as DVD audio, it is equipped with 6-channel input / output jacks, and the level of all channels can be controlled with the main volume.We have adopted TAKE II Ver. 3.0electrolytic capacitors.After SU-C1010Ver3.0has been specially designed for high sound quality after thorough trial listening of original high sound quality parts.The power transformer uses an R-core transformer with less magnetic flux leakage to prevent deterioration of sound quality.Uses a silver-palladium / gold-clad contact relay.Equipped with two pre-out terminals for bi-amping.Equipped with a wired remote function that enables you to turn the power of the power amplifier (SE-A1010) on / off.Uses an OFC power cord with polarity indication.System remote control is included."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier that is at the top of Technics'Ωs new class A amplifier that eliminates switching distortion and crossover distortion.It uses a new classA amplifier using a synchronous bias circuit unique to Technics.The synchronous bias circuit detects the positive and negative cycles of the signal prior to the output stage and always applies a constant bias to the output transistor whose amplification is stopped to prevent the occurrence of switching distortion. In addition, since the signal path and the bias current are independent, the output transistor always maintains an appropriate operating point.Furthermore, since the fast response diode switching between the positive and negative half-cycle has characteristics close to the ideal square characteristic, the new classA as a whole shows that the rise and fall waveforms of the current are very close to the ideal square characteristic, and the resultant transfer characteristic becomes a straight line near the 0cross point. This eliminates the problem of crossover distortion.The DC amplifier configuration does not include any capacitors in the signal path from input to output and in the feedback loop to obtain excellent transmission characteristics.The first stage of the circuit consists of one chip dual FET differential amplifier with uniform temperature characteristics, bootstrap cascode and current mirror load. DC drift, which is a problem in DC amplifier, is ¥10mv or less at -10Ï‰ to + 50Ï‰ by the adoption of dual FET.In the SE-A3, this first stage is followed by a differential amplified double cascode, a voltage amplification stage of a current mirror load, a 2-stage class A SEPP driver stage, a synchronous bias circuit, a PP driver of SLPT2module, and an output stage of DLPT4module.By integrating the power supply with the output stage that handles large large current, we have adopted an insulated power block that prevents electromagnetic induction, thereby greatly reducing high-frequency distortion.The newly developed DLPT (dual linear power transistor) is used as the output transistor.DLPT is a high fTSLPT (Super Linear Power Transistor) of NPN and PNP is made into a twin structure in which two SLPT (Super Linear Power Transistor) of NPN and PNP are made into one pack. Not only are the characteristics of the pair transistors well aligned, large heat capacity is realized, and stable high output is possible.In addition, because the structure is symmetrical and the emitter resistance is not dispersed, the current waveform taken out from the power block is finally the same as that of the class A operation, which greatly improves the high-frequency characteristics.The electrolytic capacitor is equipped with two newly developed low-impedance super audio capacitors (capacity 22,000Ï‰ F) per channel, for a total of four capacitors.This capacitor consists of four flat low-inductance capacitors connected in parallel and sealed in a resin case. name: SB-M3
description:
## Description

"A three way speaker system in which honeycomb flat diaphragm is adopted for all units.A honeycomb disk flat diaphragm is used as the diaphragm of each unit to solve the cavity effect caused by the time difference between the sound reproduced at the center and the outer periphery of the cone diaphragm.By adopting a honeycomb structure made of aluminum alloy, the rigidity is 1,000to 1,500times that of paper cone.When a flat diaphragm is vibrated in free space, a part (node) that does not move at all at a specific frequency appears. Technics uses a node drive that connects a voice coil to this part to drive, and cancels the resonance mode and further expands the piston motion range.In addition, the Technics employs an axisymmetric honeycomb core in which nodes are perfectly circular. Unlike the rectangular diaphragm, which has a complicated resonance mode, the Technics enables an ideal node drive.A 33cm honeycomb planar woofer is installed in the low range.By adopting a linear damper of special structure, excellent power linearity is obtained from small input to large input. In addition, by adopting large strong magnet and polyimide voice coil bobbin, efficiency and input resistance are improved.Equipped with 8cm honeycomb planar skoker in the middle area.High efficiency is achieved by narrowing the air gap between the voice coil, yoke and pole piece to the limit, and input resistance is improved by making the voice coil bobbin and voice coil highly heat-resistant.A 2.8cm honeycomb plane type tweeter is mounted in the high range.Laminated mica is used for the diaphragm skin material, and a 400g weight strarium magnet is adopted to obtain high efficiency.In addition, input resistance is improved by increasing heat radiation effect.Equipped with level control for tweeter and mid-range.Equipped with protective circuit using thermal relay."

"This bookshelf speaker system combines the technology and know-how of Monitor1, the highest level of TechnicHoneycomb Flat Speakers, into a three way system.A honeycomb disk flat diaphragm is used as the diaphragm of each unit to solve the cavity effect caused by the time difference between the sound reproduced at the center and the outer periphery of the cone diaphragm.By adopting a honeycomb structure made of aluminum alloy, the rigidity is 1,000to 1,500times that of paper cone.When a flat diaphragm is vibrated in free space, a part (node) that does not move at all at a specific frequency appears. Technics uses a node drive that connects a voice coil to this part to drive, and cancels the resonance mode and further expands the piston motion range.In addition, the Technics employs an axisymmetric honeycomb core in which nodes are perfectly circular. Unlike the rectangular diaphragm, which has a complicated resonance mode, the Technics enables an ideal node drive.A 25cm honeycomb planar woofer is installed in the low range.By adopting linear damper of special structure, excellent power linearity is obtained from small input to large input. In addition, strong magnet of 145mm diameter and 1kg weight is adopted for magnetic circuit, and high efficiency is obtained.In addition, high input resistance is realized by the adoption of polyimide voice coil bobbin, etc.An 8cm honeycomb flat skoker is mounted in the mid-range, and the unique nodal drive realizes piston motion reproduction in a wide range up to 10kHz.In addition, a down roll and an edge cover are used for the edge part to prevent secondary resonance of the diaphragm and realize smooth frequency characteristics.A 2.8cm honeycomb plane type tweeter is mounted in the high range.The magnetic circuit uses a magnet with a magnetic flux density of 16,500gauss, and the magnetic gap is filled with magnetic fluid to improve power linearity and high input resistance.Equipped with level control for tweeter and mid-range.Equipped with protective circuit using thermal relay."

In addition, since mica has a high internal loss, it is possible to reduce the inherent squeal that occurs with other metal diaphragms, and it is possible to realize a transparent high sound. In addition, the equalizer on the front of the diaphragm is eliminated to improve the quality of the high-frequency omission.The magnetic circuit uses a dual magnet structure to realize a strong driving force and anti-magnetic design.The network section uses low-distortion choke coils dedicated for audio, electrolytic capacitors for low-loss audio, and internal wiring using oxygen-free copper. The network elements are directly twisted and connected to each other for higher sound quality.The enclosure is a cross-bridged enclosure whose strength is improved by dividing the center with a single board. The spring structure allows the inside force to be can be canceled according to the needle tip.The dynamic damping mechanism prevents the reproduction signal from being modulated by the low-frequency resonance of the pickup system due to waviness of the sound groove, surface irregularities, warping, etc. of the record board. name: Technics
description:
## Description

"DD full auto player with condensed functions in LP jacket size of 31.5cm in length and width.A unique dynamic balance type linear tracking arm is linear tracking arm.In the linear tracking method, since the tone arm moves the record board in a straight line like the cutting machine, tracking error, which causes distortion, and inside force, which causes imbalance between channels, can be made very close to 0.The SL-5uses a unique linear tracking system with a tone arm mounted in the upper cabinet.The arm runs using a DC motor with high rotational accuracy and excellent response, and this motor is electronically controlled by a microcomputer. In addition, in order to improve the running accuracy, a unique optical sensor (optical non-contact detection) is used to detect the arm deflection angle near the tip of the needle of the cartridge. Unlike the detection at the bearing section, it can obtain a high-precision detection signal, and the tracking groove tracking ability of the cartridge can be controlled in an ideal state. This realizes excellent performance with a tracking error angle within ¥0.1� and an inside force of almost 0.In addition, the arm travel path is a slide bearing with a small friction coefficient to realize high-precision arm travel without unnecessary vibration caused by ball bearings and rollers.It uses a unique dynamic balance system in which the center of gravity matches the center of the arm rotation axis, and achieves stable tracing performance without strict horizontal adjustment or needle pressure adjustment.The arm bearing section has a 4-point support type gimbal suspension structure with pivot and ball bearing, and high initial motion sensitivity is obtained both horizontally and vertically.In addition, the arm has a low-mass design with an effective mass of 9g including the cartridge, and achieves a stable sound-groove follow-up performance against sleds and underlays of records.The MM type cartridge uses a multilayer laminated core with low high-frequency attenuation for all magnetic circuits.In addition to the high performance of the power generation system, the high performance of the vibration system using Technics technology has realized wide-band reproduction.A plug-in connector system is used to connect the arm and cartridge.With this system, the needle tip can be fixed at the optimum position by simply attaching it, and an appropriate needle pressure can be obtained. Moreover, the resonance frequency is set to the optimum 12Hz, making it possible to play records that demonstrate the performance of the cartridge.The drive part adopts a unique integrated structure D. D. in which the rotor of the motor is integrated with the turntable, and mechanical accuracy is pursued including the turntable.In addition, we have adopted a flat-faced slotless DC motor with current-controlled full-wave drive system that can improve the S / N ratio and reduce wow and flutter. This system does not cause performance degradation due to the characteristic variation of the Hall element for position detection, and improves rotation accuracy. In addition, in order to prevent torque efficiency degradation due to the slotless system, we have adopted a high-efficiency design that employs a unique coil structure with two layers of coils.In addition, a unique all-around detection FG is used to detect the number of revolutions, providing a more accurate detection signal than the single-point detection method.The upper and lower cabinets and bottom base are all made of TNRC (Technics Non-Resonance Compound), a unique acoustic material with excellent vibration absorption. Combined with the compact body which is hard to receive sound pressure, vibration resistance and resonance resistance are improved.It uses an electronically controlled full auto mechanism that integrates all operations into four keys.You only have to press the Start key to start playing, the record size and number of revolutions are automatically set according to the size, the arm returns to the rest when you press the Stop key while playing, the turntable stops rotating, and the arm automatically returns to the rest when you open the upper cabinet.You can freely move the arm forward and backward by holding down the start and stop keys, and up/down of the arm is controlled by the queuing keys.With the built-in repeat key, you can play repeatedly.It is designed not to work when the cabinet is open or there is no record."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"A jacket-sized linear tracking DD player with automatic track selection for any program up to 10songs.All basic operations are electronically controlled, and all operations related to record performance are electronically controlled and fully automated. This allows all operations from setting the number of revolutions to lifting and lowering the needle to be completed just by setting a record and pressing the start button.Equipped with a 10-track program automatic selection mechanism.The front of the cabinet is equipped with program buttons from 1to 10that automatically select up to 10songs according to the order in which the buttons are pressed. The LED above the button lights up when the button is pressed for easy confirmation of the program.During the performance, the LED indicating the number of songs is flashing to indicate which song is being played. In addition, since the number of songs in the record is automatically read, it is designed not to be programmed even if a button larger than the number of songs being edited is accidentally pressed.The program can be changed freely before the start button is pressed. After the start of the program performance, if you press the stop clear button, all programs will be released and the arm will return automatically. If you press the start button without pressing the program button, the program will start from the beginning of the record.The LED lights up when the repeat mechanism is activated, and pressing the repeat button again cancels the repeat operation.If you want to listen to a programmed song from the beginning, for example, while the LED of the program button is lit, you can press the button again to return to the beginning of the song.It is equipped with a search function between specified songs. During performance of a programmed song, if the arm moves forward or backward a little within the range of the sound groove of the song, the arm can be controlled forward or backward within the range of the sound groove of the specified song by moving the start button or the stop button with the quality stick.An optical sensor is used to detect between songs of a record, and moves in synchronization with the arm, and the arm is accurately lowered to the silent groove detected by the sensor.The arm employs a unique dynamic balance type linear tracking arm, which moves along the record plane in a straight line in the same way as a cutting machine. Therefore, the inside force, which causes tracking error and channel imbalance, which cause distortion, can be minimized.The arm is driven by a DC motor with high rotational accuracy, which is electronically controlled by a microcomputer. In addition, the arm deflection angle is detected by a proprietary optical sensor that operates near the needle tip of the cartridge to control the cartridge in an ideal condition.It adopts a unique dynamic balance system in which the center of gravity matches the center of the arm rotation axis, and it realizes always stable tracing performance without strict horizontal adjustment or needle pressure adjustment.In addition, the arm lifting mechanism combined with a precision gear realizes smooth operation, and the built-in muting mechanism eliminates noise that occurs when the needle tip touches or leaves the record surface.The arm bearing has a high-sensitivity gimbal suspension structure with 4-point support system using pivot and ball bearing, and high initial motion sensitivity is obtained in both horizontal and vertical directions. In addition, the arm has a low-mass design with an effective mass of 9g including the cartridge, and achieves stable sound-groove follow-up performance against the sleigh and understory of a record.The MM type cartridge uses a multilayer laminated core with low high-frequency attenuation for all of the magnetic circuit. In addition to improving the performance of the power generation system, Technics technology reduces the performance of the vibration system, enabling wide-band reproduction.The cartridge uses an easy-to-replace plug-in connector system and does not require needle pressure setting.In addition, mounting accuracy has been improved and optimum matching between the cartridge and tone arm has been achieved.In the drive system, we have adopted a unique integrated structure DD in which the rotor of the motor is integrated with the turntable, and we pursue mechanical accuracy including the turntable.The motor employs a two phase full-wave drive type flat-faced slotless motor that improves the S / N ratio and reduces wow flutter. This eliminates performance degradation due to variations in characteristics of the Hall element for position detection and improves rotational accuracy.In addition, a unique all-around detection FG is adopted for the rotational speed detection part to obtain a more advanced detection signal.The cabinet'Ωs top, bottom, and bottom base are all made of TNRC (Technics Non-Resonance Compound), a unique acoustic material with excellent vibration absorption, combined with a compact structure that is less susceptible to sound pressure, to improve vibration and resonance resistance.The 45rpm adapter is integrated around the spindle of the turntable.Synchronized recording is possible when used with the separately sold jacket size deck RS-7."

## Description

"A direct drive full auto player with quartz phase locked control.The cabinet is made of precision aluminum die-cast, and TNRC is used for the bottom base.In addition, a double anti-vibration structure (double opposed suspension) is adopted, making the structure strong against external vibration and excellent acoustic characteristics.Quartz phase-locked control is used to control the rotation of the turntable with quartz accuracy.A highly reliable all-round detection FG is used for rotational speed detection, and combined with an integrated D. D. structure and a two phase full-wave drive planar opposed slotless DC motor, excellent rotational performance is achieved.The tone arm uses a gimbal suspension system with a 4-point support structure using a pivot and ball bearing.This system has a structure in which the axes of the horizontal and vertical rotation axes intersect at one point, and has obtained a high initial motion sensitivity of 7mg.The cartridge is a MM type cartridge that uses an all-laminate core for the magnetic circuit.The presence or absence of records is automatically detected by the record detection mechanism in the turntable.In addition, if a record is not set, the tone arm is designed so that it does not move from the rest even if the player is started, preventing arm malfunction.The detection mechanism automatically detects the record size of the 30cmLP and 17cm EP discs, and an internal mechanism guides the tone arm to the outermost groove of the record according to the record size.The soft operation mechanism adopts a front operation method using an electronic control soft switch.This allows control with the dust cover closed.Equipped with a single-row strobe and prism strobe illuminator.Equipped with needle pressure adjustment and anti-skating mechanism that can be finely adjusted at 0.1g intervals."

## Description

"This full-auto player system focuses on basic performance.Quartz synthesizer system is adopted for rotation control, and excellent rotational performance with rotational speed deviation within 0.002% is achieved.A unique integrated structure DD turntable is adopted for the turntable part, and excellent characteristics are realized by integrating the motor rotor and turntable with high precision.The tone arm is equipped with a high-sensitivity gimbal suspension tone arm, which is identical in all directions and has a high initial motion sensitivity of 7mg.Equipped with T4PMM type cartridge as standard.The T4P cartridge can be mounted with high precision simply by directly inserting it and fixing it with screws.It uses a full automatic mechanism, and just set the number of revolutions and press the start button to start playing.The cabinet uses TNRC, a unique material with excellent vibration resistance.In addition, the small number of large insulators installed in this class completely eliminates vibration that adversely affects sound quality."

name: Technics
description:
## Description

"A linear tracking player that pursues performance and functions with the introduction of electronics technology.The linear tracking arm has the advantage that tracking error, which causes distortion, and inside force, which causes imbalance between channels, can be very close to 0because the needle tip moves linearly on the record board.The SL-QL1is equipped with a compact high-precision linear tracking tone arm inside the upper cabinet, and achieves excellent needle point traceability by accurate movement.The arm deflection angle, which is the running condition of the linear tracking arm, occurs as the cartridge moves.The deflection angle detection mechanism of the SL-QL1uses an optical sensor (optical non-contact detection) and microcomputer control to achieve high running accuracy. Unlike the detection at the bearing section, the deflection angle detection is performed near the tip of the cartridge needle, so that the tracking groove tracking ability of the cartridge is controlled in an ideal state. The tracking error angle is within ¥0.1� and the inside force is almost 0. Thus high running accuracy is achieved.In addition, a DC motor with extremely high rotational accuracy and excellent servo response is used for the motor for driving the arm travel. In addition, the arm travel uses a slide bearing with an extremely low friction coefficient, and the use of ball bearings and rollers realizes quiet and smooth arm travel without unnecessary vibration.The tone arm of SL-QL1uses a unique dynamic balance system in which the center of gravity is aligned with the center of rotation axis of the arm. This system eliminates the need for precise horizontal adjustment or needle pressure adjustment, making it possible to play a stable and balanced record.The arm bearing structure adopts a high-sensitivity gimbal suspension bearing structure with 4-point support system using pivot and ball bearing, and high initial motion sensitivity is obtained in both horizontal and vertical directions.In addition, the arm, including the cartridge, is a low-mass design with an effective mass of only 9g. Combined with the gimbal suspension bearing structure, it realizes a stable race performance against sleds and underlays of records.The cartridge is equipped as standard with a MM cartridge that adopts Technics'Ωs original pure boron pipe cantilever.By adopting a pure boron pipe cantilever, which is refined only with pure boron, which has an extremely high specific elastic modulus among existing elements, the vibrator has a light effective mass, and high resonance frequencies are pushed out of the range of audibility.In addition, high-frequency attenuation is minimized by adopting a multi-layer all-laminate core in the magnetic circuit. In addition, wide-band, low-distortion reproduction and excellent trace performance are realized by adopting a high-energy samarium-cobalt magnet and a one point suspension with a clearly defined vibration support point.A unique plug-in connector method is used for connection to the tone arm.In this plug-in type, the resonance peak is set at 12Hz from the design stage to obtain more ideal trace performance. In addition, poor contact and misconnection between the cartridge terminal and the arm terminal due to lead wire connection are eliminated. Since the terminal is not exposed, performance degradation is less and reliability of the connection is improved. In addition, since it is locked with a fixing screw, imperfect connection and partial resonance are prevented.In SL-QL1, MC type replacement cartridge 310mc and P-205Cmk3can be used.The drive part uses a unique integrated structure D. D. that integrates the rotor of the motor with the turntable in pursuit of mechanical accuracy.The motor employs a current-controlled full-wave drive type flat-faced slotless D. D. motor that improves the S / N ratio and reduces wow and flutter. This method improves rotational performance without deterioration caused by variations in the performances of the Hall elements for position detection. In addition, to prevent torque efficiency from decreasing due to the slotless design, a unique coil structure with two layers of coils is adopted. This design has high efficiency equivalent to the work of six split coils.In addition, high rotational performance has been achieved by means of Technics'Ωs proprietary F. G. all-around detection and quartz control that achieves excellent rotational accuracy through electronic circuit technology.The SL-QL1is equipped with a 4-bit one chip microcomputer, MN1400. This MN1400performs all automatic operations except power on/off. The microcomputer is also used not only for the full automatic mechanism but also for controlling the Quartz D. D. motor, controlling the arm drive motor, and detecting whether the cabinet is open or closed.It is equipped with a simple electronic control full auto mechanism that consolidates all operations into four keys.When a record is set and the start key is pressed, the rotation speed and record size are automatically detected and set. After the performance, the arm automatically returns to the arm rest and the turntable stops.The rotation speed can be set regardless of the record size, and this manual rotation speed setting is canceled when the dust cover is opened.When no record is set, the function does not operate even if the start key is pressed, preventing malfunction.The start and stop keys have a search function that allows you to move the tone arm forward and backward to locate the beginning of a song in the middle of middle of a record.To enjoy repeated performances, a repeat key is installed.In the case of release, if you press the stop key, the arm returns together with the repeat release and the turntable stops.Up / down of the arm can be operated by the queuing key.Since it is equipped with a muting function using relay and delay circuit, the noise which is a concern at the moment when the needle tip touches the surface of the record board and the moment when it leaves is eliminated.Both the upper and lower parts of the cabinet are made of precision aluminum die-cast, and TNRC with excellent vibration absorption is adopted for the bottom base.In addition, as a measure against external vibration, we have adopted an insulator that combines rubber and spring.Other than silver, there was also BlackCar Ra model."
